name: Borrowed Knowledge
body:
School divination; Level alchemist 2, bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, medium 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a book worth at least 25 gp)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level

You draw upon the knowledge of your ancestors or other spirits of the past. Choose one skill. For the duration you gain an insight bonus on the skill equal to your caster level and are considered trained in the skill. You cannot have multiple instances of this spell active at once.
